titre: Devoir de contrôle n°3 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
My town is called Mahdia. It is a beautiful town on the east coast of Tunisia. Mahdia is famous for its lovely beaches and its blue sea. There are many old houses with white walls and blue doors. In the town, you can find a big market where people sell fish, fruit and traditional clothes. There is also an old harbour with many fishing boats. Tourists from many countries visit Mahdia in summer. The people of the town are friendly and welcoming. I love my town because it is calm, clean and full of history.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Where is Mahdia situated?   (2 marks)
2) What is Mahdia famous for?   (2 marks)
3) What can people find in the market?   (2 marks)
4) Why does the writer love his town? Give one reason.   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "There is / There are": ______ many old houses in Mahdia.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the plural of: house ______ ; country ______.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "beautiful" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Complete with an adjective from the text: The people are ______ and welcoming.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write about your town or village (about 6-8 lines). Say where it is, what it is famous for, and what people can see or do there. Use "there is / there are" and the present simple.
